import pytest

# Adjust this import to match your module name
from your_module import celsius_to_fahrenheit


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "celsius, expected",
    [
        (0, 32),
        (100, 212),
        (-40, -40),
        (37, 98.6),
        (20, 68),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_happy_path(celsius, expected):
    assert celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius) == pytest.approx(expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "celsius, expected",
    [
        (-273.15, -459.67),  # absolute zero
        (0.1, 32.18),
        (-0.1, 31.82),
        (1_000_000, 1_800_032),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_edge_cases(celsius, expected):
    assert celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius) == pytest.approx(expected)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "invalid_value",
    [
        None,
        "100",
        [],
        {},
        object(),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_invalid_input_raises_type_error(invalid_value):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        celsius_to_fahrenheit(invalid_value)
